flood-insurance: Buying a home in Hampton Roads? Do this before you fall in love with the house.
Step one. Look up the exact address on FEMA's flood map.
Step two. Ask your lender whether flood insurance is required on your loan.
Step three. Get a real insurance quote before your inspection period ends.
Here's why. Neighboring homes can be in different flood zones, and that premium changes your monthly payment.

va-appraisal-vs-inspection: VA buyers, listen up. The appraisal is not your home inspection.
The VA appraisal checks two things. That the value supports the price, and that the home meets VA minimum property requirements.
It doesn't tell you what shape the roof, the H V A C, or the plumbing is in.
That's a home inspection, and you still want one.
Before you write an offer, ask your lender what happens if the appraisal comes in low, and what the seller can pay.

va-loan-calculator: What will your VA loan payment really be?
Don't guess. I built a free VA loan payment calculator for Hampton Roads.
It adds in the VA funding fee, property tax, insurance, flood insurance, and your BAH.

For example, on a first use VA loan with less than five percent down, the funding fee is two point one five percent. With ten percent or more down, it's one point two five. Disabled veterans may be exempt, so confirm with your lender.
Then it shows your payment as a multiple of your BAH.

price-your-home: The market doesn't care what you paid, what you owe, or what you need.
Price your home from closed sales of similar homes near you, not your neighbor's asking price.
Look at three things. What sold, how long it took, and how much sellers discounted.
Then price it for week one. Chasing the market with price cuts later usually costs you.

test-your-commute: A bad commute is a daily tax.
Test it before you make an offer. Drive it at the hours you'll actually drive.
Include the water crossings. Hampton Roads is split by bridges and tunnels.
Time it all the way to the gate, not just the drive.
Ask coworkers. They know what the maps don't show.
And compare total cost, not just distance.
